description: Use to see how much attention one ASIN gets month by month in each of five stores. Not for the product's live page (product_details) or its sales. A weekly snapshot of a cross-border search-interest proxy: what shoppers of one cross-border marketplace searched for on Amazon's US, UK, AE, IN and JP stores. A trend within that audience, not Amazon's own search volume and not live data. Price: $0.05 per answer. Products need at least 5 views to be tracked. Paid data with no free calls. Over x402 you pay $0.05 per answer; when the data holds nothing for the input the answer is a 404 and the payment is NOT settled, so a miss costs nothing. With an API key an answer costs 10 requests and a 404 costs 1. Every answer carries `snapshot`: the weeks it covers, `trend_as_of` (the last complete week; later weeks are partial) and when it was built. Updated weekly.

asin.description: Single Amazon ASIN, 10 uppercase alphanumeric characters. An Amazon product URL (…/dp/ASIN) works too, in place of an ASIN; lower case is fine. A URL's domain sets the marketplace unless geo says otherwise.
